verdict.rationale: Martin is itself an AI assistant. Its docs show users delegating calendar events, email drafting and replies, Slack messages, reminders, to-dos, notes, multi-step shortcuts and background tasks such as triage and proactive drafts. Users reach it by phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack and desktop, and community users confirm it handles complicated requests correctly and manages their to-dos day to day. Missing for 10: independent evidence of action reliability; the vendor says failure rates have improved but gives no numbers.
